notes.title: The PIXELJAM COMPLETE Megabundle + DLC Supporter Packs Are Live
notes.content:
Hello all,

Yesterday we launched PIXELJAM COMPLETE, a massive collection that brings together 14 years of our creative output in a single bundle.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6883465/52afdd3b33033872257b632aab4595fb34aa93bf.png


 20+ games & soundtracks
 Prototypes & alphas from projects we never finished
 Wallpapers, design sketches, art, gifs, comics, music & more


You can find it here: pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete

In tandem with this bundle, we are also rolling out "supporter packs" for each of our games on Steam, that contain sketches, concept art, gifs, wallpapers & soundtracks:

(click each game for its supporter pack)

Cheap Golf
Potatoman Seeks The Troof
Glorkian Warrior
Last Horizon
Dino Run DX
Gamma Bros (Launches Oct 21)
Snowball! (Launches Oct 21)

If you just want the goodies for 1 or 2 of our games, the Steam DLC's are the way to go.  However, each of them are only about 1% of the total contents of the Pixeljam Complete bundle, which is overall a much better value.

Also, if you'd like to help boost our launch signal, click here.

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Trading Cards, Full Controller Support and SPEEDRUN Timer.
notes.content:
Hello all,

We just made some significant updates to Potatoman:

1) TRADING CARDS. Collect your favorite characters from the game!

2) FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT.. All controllers should now work, and the d-pad can finally be used as well :)

3) SPEEDRUN TIMER!  Press T (or bumpers) to toggle the timer visibility on and off.  The timer will end when you collect the 7th pyramid from the last level, and give you a link to compare your time with your friends or the rest of the world.

Also, the game is now 25% off for a few more days.

Finally, Pixeljam is celebrating our 10 YEAR Anniversary this month, and we're doing a retrospective on every single game we've made... all 20 of them!

Here is the article about the making of Potatoman:
 http://pixeljam.com/blog/articles/2015/05/22/potatoman-seek-first-the-troof/.

Check out our TWITTER account for all the latest megamonth festivities!

That's all for now!  Take care...

-Miles & The Pixeljam Team

notes.title: Update #1: Bug fixes, and future content survey
notes.content:
Hello Seekers,

As usual with game launches, there were a few bugs that needed immediate squashing, so we squashed them!  Specifically a nasty error screen that can happen on the last level, and another one dealing with graphics drivers that may be out of date.  Make sure your build is the latest (466113) and you should be sorted.

More importantly, we want to add that unless an enormous boulder hits our studio and kills everyone, we intend to add some new content to the game, and we want to ask what you all would like to see:

- Trading Cards?
- New achievements?
- Something else?

Let us know!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Potatoman Will Be Released on Steam December 3rd
notes.content:
The headline explains it rather well: we will be releasing Potatoman on Steam December 3rd!  And now, some Q & A:

Q: I already have the game, will I get a key?
A:  Yes!  Depending on where you got it, it might be delivered to you automatically (like through your humble page) or you might have to contact us and claim it .

Q: Has the game changed at all?
A: YES!  
   - We altered part of the ending sequence significantly
   - We redid the rendering engine, so now the game plays smoother, has more vibrant colors and goes into true fullscreen mode
   - We added controller support (partial)
   - Each level now has multiple color palettes, to improve replayability
   - Minor bug fixes, etc.

Q: What will it cost?
A: $3.99 USD

Q: Will I find the Troof?
A: Maybe.

Okay, that's it!  We'll be posting more info here soon.

Keep on Seekin,
-The Pixeljam Team
